summary: An exec that exits while the runtime observes it keeps its exit code

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay changes.

schema.detail: The exec generation record keeps its fields; exit_code and exit_signal are now filled in a case that left them empty.

rules.detail: Restart and failure rules are unchanged; they now see the real exit of an exec that ended during an observation instead of an exit with no code.

compatibility.detail: Behavior changes only for an owned child that exits between the runtime's status check and its process read; before, that exit was recorded with no code.

downtime.detail: Takes effect on daemon restart; no migration.

recovery.detail: Binary swap-back needs no migration; an older build can again lose the code of an exec that exits mid-observation.
